    # Calculate time difference between consecutive points per component-KPI group
    anomaly_df['time_diff'] = anomaly_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name'])['timestamp'].diff().fillna(0)
    
    # Define a new segment when time difference is greater than 60 seconds (assuming 1-minute granularity)
    anomaly_df['segment'] = (anomaly_df['time_diff'] > 60).cumsum()
    
    # Group by component, KPI, segment to get fault segments
    grouped = anomaly_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name', 'segment'])
    
    fault_segments = grouped.agg(
